{"reason": "All 8 failure rows are false arbitrations; 7 have confidence<0.7 (0.44-0.67), only one is confident (0.83). Adding a high-confidence? gate removes most costly arbitrations while keeping the |pct|>0.15 and exposure>500000 gates, protecting the recall>=0.8 business gate and cutting the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
